depiction.primary_object: vertical bookmark ribbon with V-notched bottom
depiction.composition: centered bookmark outline containing a solid heart

readings.meaning: bookmarks, saved items, or reading list

ambiguity: Overlaps strongly with plain bookmark, star, or heart icons used for favorites and saved items.
